quote.text: No man has escaped paying the penalty for being born.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as life imposes its inherent costs upon every individual, parenthood demands the acceptance of both joy and hardship—a natural price for nurturing the next generation.
    • Embrace the burden as an opportunity to cultivate resilience and moral virtue in yourself and your children, transforming life's challenges into lasting strength.
  • Leadership
    • Leadership, like life itself, comes with inevitable burdens; accepting this truth can ground you in humility and prepare you to shoulder responsibility with wisdom.
    • Recognize that limitations and hardships are not curses but essential elements of growth—using them to forge a path that inspires and uplifts those you serve.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, every initiative and innovation carries its own cost, much like the birth penalty; understanding this helps to admit that setbacks are intrinsic to progress.
    • Transform challenges into learning opportunities, viewing each obstacle not as wasted effort but as the natural price paid for the advancement and evolution of your project.
